Behind the Bell Assistant

Production assistant for the Behind the Bell K-12 podcast.
Try this: "Here's our next guest [paste name/bio]. Research them and draft 8 grouped interview questions for the episode."

What it is

A shared Claude.ai Project that supports the three Behind the Bell hosts (Jessie, Pat, Adam) with episode production - guest research and prep packages, grouped interview questions, loose episode scripts, and drafted guest-outreach emails.

What it does

Produces HTML and Word output and tags every fact [CONFIRMED] or [UNVERIFIED] so nothing unverified slips on air. It is a production aid, not a sales channel.

How to access

Sign in at claude.ai with your @k12sta.com email and open Behind the Bell Assistant in your Projects list.
